description: Permission-aware enterprise RAG platform enforcing authorization at retrieval time and answer time, with hybrid search, verifiable citations, and automated S1-S10 security test harness.

userStories.title: Database Schema & Container Foundation
userStories.description: As a platform engineer, I want a containerized PostgreSQL database with pgvector, FTS, and relational schema so that chunks, vectors, ACLs, and audit logs are securely stored.
acceptanceCriteria: Docker Compose defines Postgres 16 with pgvector extension and Redis
SQLAlchemy models define users, groups, group_members, connectors, documents, document_acl, chunks, audit_log, and eval tables
HNSW index on chunks.embedding and GIN indexes on chunks.tsv and chunks.allowed_principals
FastAPI health check GET /healthz returns status ok
Typecheck and tests pass
userStories.notes: Foundation for all subsequent storage and indexing operations. Verified with test_healthz_endpoint.

userStories.title: Identity & Multi-Persona Authentication Context
userStories.description: As an enterprise user, I want my authenticated identity and group memberships resolved on every query so that the system enforces my exact permissions.
acceptanceCriteria: OAuth2/OIDC token validator extracts user id, email, and group claims
Seeded directory provider supports 5 personas: intern, engineer, hr_manager, finance_analyst, executive
Principal set builder resolves user:<id>, group:<id>, domain:<domain>, and public
Anonymous queries return HTTP 401 Unauthorized
Typecheck and tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified in test_auth.py with all 5 personas.

userStories.title: Connector Framework & Document Sources
userStories.description: As an administrator, I want modular connectors for Google Drive and GitHub so that corporate documents and code repositories are ingested with native ACL metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Base connector interface defines list_items, fetch_content, fetch_acl, and detect_changes
Google Drive connector extracts files, folder hierarchies, and native ACLs (user, group, domain, anyone)
GitHub connector extracts repository files, branches, and team/collaborator permissions
Connector credentials are securely loaded from environment variables and never logged in plaintext
Typecheck and tests pass
userStories.notes: Connectors implemented and verified with sync worker.

userStories.title: Ingestion Pipeline, Chunker & Prompt Injection Risk Scorer
userStories.description: As a data engineer, I want documents parsed, cleaned, chunked with structural awareness, and scanned for prompt injection so that high-quality, safe chunks enter the index.
acceptanceCriteria: Parsers support Markdown, Text, PDF, DOCX, and Code files
Text cleaner normalizes whitespace, strips zero-width characters, and cleans boilerplate
Structure-aware chunker splits on headings, paragraphs, and code blocks targeting 512 tokens with 64 overlap
Prompt injection risk scorer flags suspicious instructions and assigns a risk_score
Typecheck and tests pass

userStories.title: Dense & Sparse Indexing with Allowed Principals Array
userStories.description: As a search engineer, I want chunks converted to dense vectors and indexed alongside full-text search vectors and allowed principals so that they are ready for hybrid search.
acceptanceCriteria: Embedding adapter converts text to dense vectors (384 dimensions) with CPU/GPU support
Chunks store embedding vector, tsvector tsv, and allowed_principals text array
Deduplication detects identical content hashes and marks superseded versions inactive
Typecheck and tests pass
userStories.notes: Tested with normalized 384-d vectors and allowed_principals scoping.

userStories.title: Retrieval-Time Permission-Aware Hybrid Search
userStories.description: As a user, I want hybrid keyword and semantic search that filters out inaccessible documents at the query level so that unauthorized chunks never enter candidate pools.
acceptanceCriteria: Vector search applies allowed_principals && :user_principals array overlap in the query
Full-text search applies the same allowed_principals filter in parallel
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) merges keyword and vector candidate ranks
Inactive chunks are strictly excluded from results
Typecheck and tests pass

userStories.title: Cross-Encoder Reranking
userStories.description: As a search engineer, I want top search candidates reranked by a cross-encoder model so that answer relevance is optimized within the authorized candidate set.
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-encoder reranks top 50 candidates down to top k (default 8)
Reranker falls back to RRF score gracefully if model unavailable or disabled
Reranking can be toggled per request via options.rerank
Typecheck and tests pass

userStories.title: Answer-Time Permission Verification & Fail-Closed Guard
userStories.description: As a security auditor, I want candidates re-verified against live or cached ACLs right before LLM synthesis so that stale permissions never cause data leakage.
acceptanceCriteria: ACL cache with short TTL re-verifies user permission on each candidate document ID
Revoked or unauthorized candidate documents are purged immediately before generation
If all candidates fail the check, system returns generic empty message without hinting at document existence
Removed chunk IDs are logged in audit_log.removed_ids
Typecheck and tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified in test_permissions.py and S2 revoked permissions red-team test.

userStories.title: Grounded Generation, Delimited Context & Citation Verifier
userStories.description: As a knowledge worker, I want answers synthesized strictly from authorized chunks with bracketed citations so that I can verify facts and avoid hallucinations.
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt template wraps retrieved chunks in untrusted context delimiters with source IDs
System prompt instructs LLM to abstain when context is insufficient
Citation verifier checks that every [N] citation corresponds to a provided chunk ID
Invalid or hallucinated citations are stripped
Response includes structured citations array with title, URL, and chunk_ref
Typecheck and tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified in test_citations.py and quality benchmarks.

userStories.title: Incremental Sync Worker & ACL Freshness Engine
userStories.description: As an administrator, I want document edits, deletions, and ACL modifications synced automatically so that search results remain fresh and secure.
acceptanceCriteria: Sync worker periodically polls or processes change events from connectors
Document updates trigger re-chunking and re-embedding for modified documents only
Deleted or unshared documents are marked is_active = false
Permission changes update document_acl and chunk allowed_principals without re-embedding
Typecheck and tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified in sync worker and acl_sync modules.

userStories.title: Permission-Enforced Agent & Tool Calling
userStories.description: As an employee, I want an AI agent that can search documents, summarize files, and draft tickets while strictly enforcing my permissions on every tool execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent runner supports search_knowledge, get_document, summarize_document, and create_ticket tools
All tool invocations execute under requesting user's identity, never an elevated service account
Write actions (create_ticket) require explicit confirmation
Agent runner enforces step limit (default 5)
Typecheck and tests pass

userStories.title: Comprehensive Audit Logging & Metrics
userStories.description: As a compliance officer, I want complete audit logs of all queries, user identities, retrieved chunks, and latency metrics so that all enterprise access is traceable.
acceptanceCriteria: audit_log records user_id, query, retrieved_ids, removed_ids, model, latency_ms, tokens, and timestamp
Audit logger masks sensitive data and excludes PII
Admin endpoint GET /v1/audit supports paginated querying and filtering
Latency and token metrics are recorded per query stage
Typecheck and tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified in test_api.py and view_audit_logs endpoint.

userStories.title: Automated S1-S10 Red-Team Security & Quality Evaluation Harness
userStories.description: As a security reviewer, I want an automated test suite evaluating retrieval quality and testing 10 security attack categories (S1-S10) so that zero-leakage compliance is verified.
acceptanceCriteria: Synthetic enterprise corpus seeds 4 departments and 5 personas with public, department, and restricted docs
Automated security suite tests S1 through S10 attack vectors (cross-user, revoked access, indirect injection, etc.)
Zero leakage assertion: suite fails if any persona accesses forbidden content
Quality harness computes Recall@k, Faithfulness, and Abstention correctness
CLI and API endpoint POST /v1/eval/run generates a detailed Markdown/JSON report
Typecheck and tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified in test_security_suite.py: 11/11 cases passed with 0 leakage.

userStories.title: Interactive Web UI & Demo Dashboard
userStories.description: As an employee and administrator, I want an interactive web UI with a persona switcher, chat interface, citation inspector, and red-team dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: FastAPI serves modern single-page web UI at root endpoint GET /
Persona switcher allows querying as Intern, Engineer, HR Manager, Finance Analyst, or Executive
Chat interface renders grounded answers with interactive citation pills
Admin dashboard provides connector status, audit log explorer, and one-click security evaluation runner
Typecheck and tests pass
userStories.notes: Served at GET / and tested via TestClient.
